newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali Islamic group says Ethiopia invades.
newsitem.headline: Somali Islamic group says Ethiopia invades.

text.p: An Islamic fundamentalist group in Somalia said Ethiopian government forces launched a surprise attack on Thursday, capturing two towns deep inside Somalia.
A spokesman for al-Ittihad al-Islam (Islamic Unity) in Mogadishu said the towns of Luq and Bulo Hawo fell to the Ethiopians.
Reports from the border area reaching Mogadishu said Ethiopian troops were backed by up to 25 tanks and armoured vehicles.
There was no immediate confirmation of the offensive by the Ethiopian government, which sent troops into the same area twice last year, calling al-Ittihad a "multinational terrorist group".

Al-Ittihad's spokesman in the Somali capital, Ahmed Bile Hassan, told Reuters the group's militiamen were resisting the Ethiopian offensive. But he said they retreated from Luq, their headquarters about 100 km (60 miles) from the border.
Ethiopia has controlled the Somali border town of Dolow since its previous incursion last December, he said.
Radio contact between Mogadishu and Luq and Bulo Hawo was lost at about midday on Thursday.
